# Using an effort in Pi

Use `using_effort` explicitly as `{ effort: "<canonical-slug>" }` to attach or `{ detach: true }` to detach. Pi remains at repository root; use the supplied relative memory path `.awf/efforts/<slug>/memory.md` and, when present, managed-worktree path `.awf/worktrees/<slug>` for effort work.

A takeover is advisory and proceeds. Heartbeat and complete metadata are advisory only. When available, awf publishes the effort slug as a display-only suffix; it never reads or composes a base name and the suffix is never routing input. Activity is neither authority nor a lock. Restart begins detached.

When attached, prefer `effort_memory_read` for pathless reads, `effort_memory_edit` only for Markdown body changes, and `effort_memory_update` for `phase` or `next`. Their timestamps are automatic. Generic file tools and direct awf commands remain available.
